nodes.description: long-term galvanostatic cycling vs activated carbon in 21m NH₄TFSI
nodes.source_text: the A-PBA cycled in 21m NH₄TFSI electrolyte displayed the most stable performance with only ∼9.1% capacity loss even after 300 cycles... almost no dissolved Mn/Fe ions (<0.5 ppm).

a control A-PBA was first cycled in a 21m NH₄TFSI electrolyte for 10 cycles and then cycled in a diluted 2m NH₄TFSI electrolyte. The corresponding capacity falls off rapidly in the latter electrolyte.

nodes.description: full NH₄⁺ battery A-PBA||PTCDI in 21m NH₄TFSI
nodes.source_text: the full NH₄⁺ battery consisting of the A-PBA cathode, organic PTCDI anode, and 21m NH₄TFSI electrolyte exhibits a high capacity of 50.8 mAh/g with an average voltage of ∼1.2 V at 40 mA/g and an excellent capacity retention of 72.3% after 4000 cycles at 400 mA/g, with a Coulombic efficiency of 99.6%.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD pattern indicates the presence of a typical monoclinic phase structure for A-PBA (Figure 1a).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Xray diffraction (XRD) pattern of A-PBA indicates the presence of a typical monoclinic phase structure (Figure 1a).

nodes.characterization_summary: A-PBA exhibits cubic morphology with edge length of dozens of nanometers.
nodes.evidence_snippet: A cubic morphology with an edge length of dozens of nanometers is observed from the scanning electron microscopy (SEM) image (inset of Figure 1a).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ex-situ XRD shows highly reversible framework deformation of A-PBA during cycling in 21m NH₄TFSI electrolyte, expanding when charged (NH₄⁺ deinsertion) and shrinking back when discharged.
nodes.evidence_snippet: This remarkable stability of A-PBA in the highly concentrated electrolyte was further demonstrated by the ex-situ XRD measurement. It indicates a highly reversible A-PBA deformation during cycling in 21m NH₄TFSI electrolyte, where the framework expanded when charged (NH₄⁺ deinsertion) and can reversibly shrink back in the following discharge (NH₄⁺ insertion), as shown in Figure 1e.
